entry.title: Shabla Lighthouse
entry.note: +Y up; +Z points roughly north (2.71 degrees true), the stacked tower openings face north, the attached keeper house extends south (-Z), and +X door/steps face inland/west. Municipal tower coordinates and mapped house axis choose the sign; the exact-QID OSM node is an identity control with an approximately18.3m southward position discrepancy. Municipal embedded tower coordinates are the position control, not an engineering survey. The exact-QID OSM node lies about18.3m south, and its identity alone does not validate its point position. North-up aerial and the inspected July2026 west-side photograph establish house/tower quadrant; photo metadata azimuth312 disagrees with the GPS-to-tower direction and is not used as a bearing. House centering follows the mapped rectangle; its scale, 8.5m square tower base, taper, windows, floor allocation, rail spacing and fittings remain photo proportions. Towerheight32m is distinct from focalheight36m; Y0 uses host terrain contact, not surveyed sea level. Detached station buildings, hedges, shore and interiors are not part of this asset. Paint age and individual masonry are generalized. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
